text: {"label":"Pigeon Inference and Comparative Cognition","definition":"Studies using pigeons as an avian model of complex cognition, such as inference by exclusion, numerical or distance effects in choice, and delayed matching-to-sample performance.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on cognitive-style phenomena like exclusion and distance effects, rather than visual discrimination and stimulus control, key-peck response properties, or reinforcement-parameter choice and discounting."}
